config.notes: WITT, Western Institute of Technology at Taranaki (business division of Te Pukenga / NZIST); host www.witt.ac.nz/study/; server-rendered text, no page JSON. Header: Campus X, Intakes dd/mm/yyyy, Duration, Domestic Fees, International Fees $x.00*; further INTAKE dd/mm/yyyy headings lower down (read too, pick all). Intakes are not split domestic/international on WITT pages. term_months maps the page's own mm/yyyy date parts to month names for 2026-2028 (extend each year). Fee: the fee-exclusion note says international fees are for 1 year of study (120 credits) OR as specified for the programme, so the fee is read only when Duration is 1 to 4 years full-time, or as the (Year 1) amount; semester / week-length programme totals and per-level amounts (Dairy Farming L3/L4) are not read. IELTS: '(IELTS) score of X (general or academic)' or 'overall IELTS (Academic) band score of X'. online.witt.ac.nz pages are not matched (identity_mismatch). Delivery (mode): WITT pages print no separate delivery label; the header's "Campus <name>" (on campus) is read, or "Delivered online with flexible intakes" printed in the Duration slot (online). 5 Oct: entry_requirement (review only): the 'Entry Requirements' section (General admission text) up to the English language requirements. No exit awards or whole-course fees printed.
